acceptance_criteria.statement: The Pack validates and compiles to Codex, declares no MCP/database/SQL/code execution/provider mutation, and keeps all four agents and its skill Pack-owned.

One canonical frozen corpus has six positive and six negative cases, stable digest 8581b32eb37d09114dd63ba4da0a0ed4c57f1847a5920aaf195735528af84df7, and Waza output is generated from it without invented negative destination routes.
Fixture tests distinguish observed invocation, non-invocation, and unknown; specialist roles come from events or remain unknown; final response prose is not evidence.
The local scratch Git project contains only the generated Pilot A plugin and project-local Codex agents, has no MCP configuration or remote, and does not require an external repository.

A complete run is exactly 24 sequential harness invocations, one per case/arm, with zero automatic retries and an enforced stop on invocation/evidence failure; provider-call counts are never claimed as preflight-enforced.

Results preserve expected/actual trigger and route, completion checks, usage telemetry, latency, delegations, validation failures, content/revision digests, raw artifact references, and separate standard and legacy false-positive rates.
All Stage 0 validations are deterministic and pass; no Codex/model trials, Waza model evaluation, or SkillOpt runs occur.
Independent QA and Reviewer pass, a local commit exists, and the semantic branch has a PR to develop that remains unmerged.
